meta.note: Captured 124 unique confirmed acts — the full day-by-day breakdown for both weekends, as reported by KVUE (Austin) on 2026-05-12 based on ACL's own by-day lineup graphic, cross-validated line-by-line against the official Live Nation/C3 Presents press release (2026-05-05). No stages or set times exist yet (C3 Presents has explicitly said daily set-time schedules "will be announced at a later date"), so those fields are null throughout. Two corrections applied versus the raw KVUE text: (1) KVUE's W1-Friday list had "Brandon Thomas" immediately after "Leon Thomas" — this is an evident OCR/typo error for "Brandon Flowers" (of The Killers), confirmed by the official press release's identical adjacent ordering and by three other outlets (BrooklynVegan, CultureMap, Billboard) explicitly naming Brandon Flowers as a Weekend-1-only act; (2) KVUE listed Izzy Escobar under both weekends' Friday bills, but the official Live Nation press release explicitly tags "Izzy Escobar(W1)" — the official/primary source was trusted over the secondary compilation. One quality-control flag: a few aggregator sites (e.g., liveforlivemusic.com) list The Marías, Role Model, Rilo Kiley, Djo, Pierce The Veil, and Sabrina Claudio as part of the 2026 bill. None of these appear in the official Live Nation press release, the KVUE day-by-day breakdown, or BrooklynVegan's coverage — and all six performed at ACL 2025, so this reads as a copy-paste/template carryover error in that one article rather than a confirmed 2026 booking. Deliberately excluded here; flag to Kevin if seen elsewhere.
